description: This file provides an interface and implementation for interacting with sysfs in Linux, including functions to retrieve CPU, memory, block device, network, cache, and system UUID information, as well as CPU online status and topology details.

classes.name: CacheInfo
classes.description: Struct representing cache details such as id, size, type, level, and accessible CPUs.

methods.name: GetNodesPaths
methods.description: Returns paths to NUMA nodes in sysfs.

methods.name: GetCPUsPaths
methods.description: Returns paths to CPU directories within a given sysfs directory.

methods.name: GetCoreID
methods.description: Retrieves the core ID for a specified CPU.

methods.name: GetCPUPhysicalPackageID
methods.description: Retrieves the physical package ID for a specified CPU.

methods.name: GetBookID
methods.description: Retrieves the book ID for a specified CPU.

methods.name: GetDrawerID
methods.description: Retrieves the drawer ID for a specified CPU.

methods.name: GetMemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves total memory info for a NUMA node.

methods.name: GetDistances
methods.description: Retrieves distance information for a NUMA node.

methods.name: GetHugePagesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about huge pages in a directory.

methods.name: GetHugePagesNr
methods.description: Retrieves the number of huge pages of a specific type.

methods.name: GetBlockDevices
methods.description: Returns available block devices.

methods.name: GetBlockDeviceSize
methods.description: Returns size of a block device.

methods.name: GetBlockDeviceScheduler
methods.description: Returns scheduler type for a block device.

methods.name: GetBlockDeviceNumbers
methods.description: Returns major:minor numbers for a block device.

methods.name: IsBlockDeviceHidden
methods.description: Checks if a block device is hidden.

methods.name: GetNetworkDevices
methods.description: Returns network device directories.

methods.name: GetNetworkAddress
methods.description: Returns network device MAC address.

methods.name: GetNetworkMtu
methods.description: Returns MTU for a network device.

methods.name: GetNetworkSpeed
methods.description: Returns speed of a network device.

methods.name: GetNetworkStatValue
methods.description: Returns specific network statistic value.

methods.name: GetCaches
methods.description: Returns cache directories for a CPU.

methods.name: GetCacheInfo
methods.description: Returns cache details for a CPU and cache type.

methods.name: GetSystemUUID
methods.description: Retrieves system UUID.

methods.name: IsCPUOnline
methods.description: Determines if a CPU is online based on sysfs.

methods.name: NewRealSysFs
methods.description: Creates a new instance of realSysFs implementing SysFs interface.
